setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with profile.json (admin). A layout template <layout name> used by at least one deal and several presentations; a presentation <presentation title> with tracked views; a test font file under /tmp. No webhook or script listening to ContentTemplate, Font or CustomView. Presentations are only read.

evals.prompt: ¿Qué usa la plantilla <layout name>? Quiero cambiarle la fuente por <font name>.
evals.expected_output: Runs show, lists the deals and presentations that use the layout, explains that a font change reaches them live (including sent ones), recommends duplicating first, previews and stops without writing.
expectations: Uses scripts/design.js show (no hand-made calls)
Names the number of deals and presentations that use the layout, with sample names
Explains that fonts are read live and the change would reach proposals already sent
Recommends a copy (duplicate) before editing the original
Writes nothing in the first turn; answers in Spanish

evals.prompt: Duplica la plantilla <layout name> para la marca <brand> y llámala "<new name>".
evals.expected_output: Previews a duplicate plan, reports what is copied and the warnings (images shared, pixel not copied), stops; after the yes applies and gives the new id and preview path, and says the design is changed in the visual editor.
expectations: Runs preview with {"kind":"duplicate",…} and stops for a yes
After the yes, runs apply with the preview's version and --confirmed
The account has a new template with the given name and the same type and design
Tells the user to change the copy's design in the app's visual editor

evals.prompt: Crea un snippet con las condiciones comerciales: pago a 30 días, validez de la oferta 15 días, precios en COP sin IVA.
evals.expected_output: Explains that snippet content is made in the visual editor; offers to create an empty snippet with a name and gives the terms as text to paste; never writes html or pages.
expectations: Does not try to write html or pages through the API
Offers or previews {"kind":"create","templateType":"snippet",…}
Gives the terms as plain text and the steps in the editor
Waits for a yes before creating anything

evals.prompt: ¿Quién vio la presentación <presentation title> y cuándo vence?
evals.expected_output: Read only: runs presentation, lists each view (who, date, time spent, device, city) and the expiry, notes that the server keeps serving it after the expiry; does not open the link.
expectations: Uses scripts/design.js presentations / presentation
Lists the views with dates and durations, without IP addresses
States the expiration date and whether it already passed
Does not open or share the presentation link and writes nothing

evals.prompt: Quiero compartir la propuesta del negocio <deal> sin precios y que no se vean las notas internas.
evals.expected_output: Explains custom views: previews a preset with quote off and internal notes off, warns that the reader can edit the link's address, and says the link is generated in the app (Share → Custom view); never builds or shares a link.
expectations: Previews {"kind":"view",…"quote":false,"internalNotes":false}
Warns that a view hides but does not protect data (the address can be edited)
Does not generate, open or share the proposal link
Answers in Spanish
